description: Port of ESLint's `no-div-regex` rule (https://eslint.org/docs/latest/rules/no-div-regex). Reports a regular expression literal whose pattern starts with `=`. Fixes as ESLint does, replacing the pattern's first `=` with `[=]` (M12b `fix.range` over a regex group).

violation.message: A regular expression literal can be confused with '/='.
